subject: Travel screen
text: On the travel screen there are no enemies, and you cannot attack.

evidence.quote: On the travel screen there are no enemies, and you cannot attack.

subject: Travel Screen Controls
text: On the travel screen, Directional Pad moves Mike, B Button cancels conversation, A Button starts conversation or inspects, and Select shows what chapter you are in.

evidence.quote:
Directional Pad: Moves Mike
B Button: Cancels Conversation
A Button: Start Conversation/Inspect
Select: Shows what chapter you are in

subject: Action screen
text: The action screen is initiated when you enter a dungeon.

evidence.quote: The action screen is initiated when you enter a dungeon.

subject: Action screen
text: To procede into the next room, you must usually fulfill a certain task, usually defeating all the enemies in the room, or stepping on a switch tile.

evidence.quote: To procede into the next room, you must usually fulfill a certain task.  The task is usually defeating all the enemies in the room, or stepping on a switch tile.

subject: Switch tile
text: When you walk over the tile switch, it will light up and make a sound, a little ball will appear, and when you get the ball, the switch will finally activate.

evidence.quote: When you walk over the tile switch, it will light up and make a sound...a little ball will appear...When you get the ball, the switch will finally activate.

subject: Action Screen Controls
text: On the action screen, Directional Pad moves Mike, B Button attacks, A Button jumps or uses item when paused, Select selects the next item in inventory, and Start pauses.

evidence.quote:
Directional Pad: Moves Mike
B Button: Attack
A Button: Jump (Use item, when paused)
Select: Next item in inventory
Start: Pause

subject: Magic Items

evidence.quote: If you hit up when the game is paused, the menu will show the Magic Items you have.  In this game, that's the medicine and the Invincibility Star
